name: Omanym
author: leewynne
description: Name your AI, bot or agent from your Omarchy bar: a blinking hexagon robot with a Bot of the Day from namemyai.org's 900 famous robots, AIs and sci-fi characters, plus name ideas for whatever your bot does. One click copies the name.

barWidget.description: Name your AI: a Bot of the Day from namemyai.org to copy, shuffle or look up, and name suggestions for what your bot does, from coding to research.
